verdict.rationale: Productboard's own site states that it automatically detects insights within feedback that can be linked to related feature ideas. Its docs also describe linking notes to features to quantify demand, and AI-surfaced feedback findings that come with citations. The core of the story is first-party claimed, but only in a single marketing sentence, and that sentence says insights 'can be linked' rather than clearly stating the AI links them itself. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how the AI detection and linking work, explicit confirmation that linking is automatic rather than suggested, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on AI to automatically detect insights within feedback and link them to related feature ideas

citations.quote: Productboard automatically detects insights within feedback that can be linked to related feature ideas.
Notes can be linked to features to quantify demand and inform prioritization.
Productboard includes citations for every finding, so decisions are always backed by evidence.
